title: The ordinary rate 575/331776 clears the width threshold at 2^20
body:
## Summary
- At `c = 1/576`, the ordinary saving is `c(1-c) = 575/576^2 = 575/331776`, above the selected kappa and not adopted.
- The doubled width estimate gives `32780 · (17/16) · 20 = 696575 < 2^20`, and `2^(20/576) < 17/16`.
- Partial receipt only. No new kappa, and no moment enclosure.
